title.narrative: Support to the EU's Bilateral Relations with Strategic Partners on Climate-related Policies and Investment.

description.narrative: The objective of this action is to promote the effective implementation of the Paris Agreement in the context of economic recovery from the pandemic crisis. By fostering exchange and collaboration among national and subnational administrations, business communities, academia and civil society stakeholders, the action encourages and assists the EU and other major economies in making their best efforts towards the goals and full implementation of the Paris Agreement.
